title: Condition (B) for a flat locally constant constructible sheaf
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $\Lambda=\mathbf F_\ell$, let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian $\Lambda$-algebra. Work with module sheaves and their ordinary derived categories on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Constructible means locally constant with finitely generated stalks on a finite locally closed stratification [def-constructible-stratification], [def-weil-pbc-locally-constant-finite-type-modules], [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. A Galois partition $\mathcal P$ is a finite locally closed stratification of $X$ by connected reduced subschemes $S_i$, with a connected finite etale Galois covering $V_i\to S_i$ for each stratum. Here Galois means that a finite group acts on the cover and acts simply transitively on every geometric fibre. Let $\mathcal W_{\mathcal P}(A)$ be the class of sheaves whose restriction to each $S_i$ is a filtered colimit of sheaves obtained by finite successive extensions of locally constant $A$-module sheaves which become constant on $V_i$. No finite-generation condition is imposed in $\mathcal W_{\mathcal P}(A)$. Write $D^b_{\mathcal P}(X,A)$ for bounded complexes whose cohomology sheaves belong to this class. Let $F$ be a locally constant constructible flat sheaf of $A_X$-modules, where flat means that tensoring module sheaves with $F$ is exact. For every Galois partition $\mathcal P$, there is a Galois partition $\mathcal P\prime$ such that for every $u\le v$ and $N\in D^b_{\mathcal P}(X,A)\cap D^{[u,v]}$, one has $R\mathcal Hom_A(F,N)\in D^b_{\mathcal P\prime}(X,A)\cap D^{[u,v]}$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. If $N$ is constructible, then this internal Hom is constructible. The partition may be chosen to refine $\mathcal P$; no dualizing hypothesis is required. Locally constant is meant etale-locally, as in [def-weil-pbc-locally-constant-finite-type-modules]: $F$ is not assumed to become constant on a finite etale cover of a connected component of $X$, since with infinite finitely generated stalks such a cover need not exist.

source.place: Expose XVII, Lemma 7.6.11 and proof of Proposition 7.6.9, p. 314
